crossRefs.note: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Judah, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.
These are the families of Judah according to those who were counted of them, seventy-six thousand five hundred.

translations.web: His division, and those who were counted of them, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.
translations.kjv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.
translations.asv: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.
